description: This file contains unit tests for PDF signature functionality in the PDFsharp library, including signing new PDFs, signing existing PDFs, and signing and encrypting PDFs. It includes test cases for various certificate types, digest algorithms, and timestamp servers, as well as integration with certificate store and custom appearance handlers.

classes.name: DefaultSignerTests
classes.description: A test class containing methods to test PDF signing and encryption functionalities.

methods.name: Sign_new_file_with_DefaultAppearance
methods.description: Creates a new PDF document, adds content, applies digital signature with default appearance handler, and saves it.

methods.name: Sign_new_file_Default
methods.description: Creates a new PDF document with sample content, signs it with specified certificate and digest type, optionally with timestamp.

methods.name: Sign_new_file_Default_in_a_loop
methods.description: Repeatedly creates and signs new PDF documents in a loop, testing performance and consistency.

methods.name: Sign_existing_file_Default
methods.description: Opens an existing PDF file, applies a digital signature, and saves the signed document.

methods.name: Sign_with_Certificate_from_Store
methods.description: Signs a PDF document using a certificate retrieved from the Windows certificate store.

methods.name: Sign_and_encrypt_file_Default
methods.description: Signs and encrypts a PDF document, then reads and saves it unencrypted for verification.

methods.name: GetCertificate
methods.description: Loads an X509 certificate from a file given the certificate name.
